verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing page and no documentation of seat types, tier prices, or which AI-agent features are gated by plan. The only plan reference is a help-article note that static file hosting is available on Pro and Enterprise plans. That is a single non-AI feature-availability mention, not published plan pricing that clarifies seats, tiers, or AI gating.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
